''See also: [[Presence Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A Presence is a specialized mental [[construct]] or tool used by certain individuals, such as [[Judges]], to assist with information processing and environmental awareness. Functioning as an internal companion that lives within the mind, it communicates through a combination of spoken words, thoughts, and direct sensory impressions. These constructs are capable of retrieving vast amounts of data, performing complex predictions, analyzing historical artifacts, and monitoring spatial stability or imminent violations. They can also provide warnings regarding incoming threats or changes in population and surroundings. While a Presence serves as an advanced repository for facts and data, it is considered a tool rather than a replacement for personal judgment and education. Users are expected to make their own decisions based on the information provided by their Presence. The appearance and personality of a Presence can vary; for example, some users choose to manifest their Presence as a humanoid figure to alleviate the psychological strain of isolation. In certain high-level contexts, Presences can also interact with one another or provide collective warnings.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Suriel's Presence]] is a gray figure composed of smoke that rests upon her shoulder. In contrast, other manifestations include [[Pariana]]'s Presence, which appears as a squirming mass of silver, and [[Cirian]]'s Presence, which is a cube of blue light.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Presence acts as an independent manifestation capable of speaking and communicating with its host. It acknowledges commands, reports information, signals intent, and can provide warnings regarding suspicious activity or deviations.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Presence acts as a component of [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]], assisting her by reporting data and acknowledging her commands. It also functions to provide information regarding [[Lindon|Wei Shi Lindon]] for [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This entity functions as a tool for reporting data, such as population counts and coordinates, and can detect barriers. It is capable of scouring the future for simple predictions, summoning images, projecting reports, and materializing a simple white uniform.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Abidan testing}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A Presence is a specific type of power or entity utilized during [[Abidan]] testing.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref> These entities are capable of signaling intent and communicating, such as when the Presence delivered a warning from [[Sector Eleven Control]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 13</ref> While [[Cirian]]'s Presence appears as a cube of blue light, a [[Reaper]]'s Presence is able to manifest in the form of a creature.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> Used by trainers as a guiding force, the Presence also serves as a tool with a memory greater than that of a person.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 10</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Cirian]]'s [[Presence]] is a cube of blue light.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Presences can communicate and signal intent.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[Reaper]]'s [[Presence]] can manifest as a creature.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Presence]] is a guiding force used by trainers.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[Presence]] is a tool that can remember more than a person.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Presence]] delivered the warning from [[Sector Eleven Control]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13" />}}</li>
